**[Get WhisperShortcut on the Mac App Store](https://whispershortcut.com/go/appstore?src=github-release)** — automatic updates, one-time purchase.

## Dictation templates
- **Templates run on their own.** A template recording no longer borrows Dictate Prompt's setup: it does not pick up your writing style, memory rules or look-up tools, so the result follows the template more closely. Dictate Prompt (⌘2) is unchanged.
- **Selected text goes into the template.** With text selected, a template recording now formats it into the template instead of editing it like Dictate Prompt. The recording card shows the template's name in this case too.
- **Templates now work in the App Store version with cloud models**, where they were previously skipped.
- The Template shortcut is ignored while a Dictate Prompt recording is running.

## Smart Improvement
- **Paused in Offline Mode, and it says so.** While Offline Mode is on, the Smart Improvement controls are greyed out with a short note. Your setting is kept, and learning resumes when you turn Offline Mode off.

## Usage statistics
- **More detailed, still anonymous.** If you have opted in to usage statistics, they now count which features you use (for example screenshots, quick prompts or meeting chat) and which setup options are on. Only counts and on/off flags are sent, never content. Settings shows exactly what is sent.

## Installation
Download the DMG from the [releases page](https://github.com/mgsgde/whisper-shortcut/releases), open it, and drag WhisperShortcut to your Applications folder.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/mgsgde/whisper-shortcut/compare/v8.72...v8.73
